Name: Instant World Events
Author: Spiderbuttons
Description:
This mod aims to make certain world events happen sooner than they might otherwise. Particularly, it makes the Abandoned Joja Mart and the Giant Stump events occur as soon as the prerequisites are met. Normally, the former requires it to rain/storm, and the latter only has a 10% chance of happening each day after completing the Pantry bundle. With this mod, both of these events will occur regardless of these RNG checks.

As well, it also removes the waiting time between Raccoon bundles. Once you complete one raccoon bundle, you can come back tomorrow to get the next bundle, rather than wait a week like in vanilla.

Each of these three options is configurable, so you can choose which events you want to remove the wait for.

[b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Extract the mod into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI
[/list]
[size=5][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].
